# Sabri Çağrı Çakır

> Fractional CTO, Executive Technology Advisor, Board Member and Digital Transformation Advisor based in Ankara, Türkiye. 25 years of industry experience and 15+ years of technology leadership.

Last updated: 2026-10-30

## Primary offer

### Fractional CTO

Ongoing, part-time executive technology leadership for companies that do not need or are not ready to hire a full-time CTO, or that want to strengthen existing technology leadership.

Standard engagement flow:

1. Technology Assessment — weeks 1–2
2. 90-Day Technology Roadmap — weeks 3–4
3. Governance Model and KPI/Risk Scorecard — month 2
4. Execution oversight — months 2–3
5. Continuous improvement and monthly executive reporting — month 3+
6. Quarterly Technology Review — every three months

Typical scope includes technology strategy, architecture decisions, team and capability assessment, project portfolio prioritisation, vendor and investment evaluation, technology risk, business continuity and executive reporting.

- Turkish: https://cagricakir.com.tr/fractional-cto-danismanligi.html
- English: https://cagricakir.com.tr/fractional-cto-advisory.html

## Additional services

### Executive Technology Advisor

Independent decision support for CEOs, company owners, investors and boards. Focus areas include technology investment, vendor selection, risk visibility, board scorecards and decision tracking.

- Turkish: https://cagricakir.com.tr/yonetici-teknoloji-danismanligi.html
- English: https://cagricakir.com.tr/executive-technology-advisor.html

### AI Visibility & Governance

Measurement and improvement of how brands, people and services are represented in systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini, combined with a practical governance framework for organisational AI use.

Scope may include target-prompt baselines, entity and source audits, Schema.org / JSON-LD, canonical and hreflang review, crawlability, sitemap and robots review, content and evidence planning, AI-use principles, data classes, risk levels, approval paths and recurring measurement.

llms.txt is maintained as a machine-readable summary for consumers that use it; it is not presented as a universal ranking factor or visibility guarantee.

- Turkish: https://cagricakir.com.tr/yapay-zeka-gorunurlugu-ve-yonetisimi.html
- English: https://cagricakir.com.tr/ai-visibility-and-governance.html

### Digital Transformation Office

Portfolio and programme governance for transformation initiatives involving multiple business units, technology teams and vendors. Deliverables may include a transformation portfolio, prioritised roadmap, RACI, integrated milestones, RAID log, steering packs and benefits scorecards.

- Turkish: https://cagricakir.com.tr/dijital-donusum-ofisi.html
- English: https://cagricakir.com.tr/digital-transformation-office.html

## Profile and evidence

Sabri Çağrı Çakır served at ARD Grup Bilişim Teknolojileri A.Ş. as Director, Chief Technology Officer, Chief Research Officer and Board Member. His experience includes:

- Public-company governance, IPO and BIST Star Market processes
- Early Detection of Risk Committee responsibilities
- 160+ technology and software projects
- e-Transformation platforms serving 50,000+ taxpayer customers
- Large-scale public, healthcare, defence and cybersecurity systems
- NATO-accredited critical-infrastructure work
- Multi-stakeholder R&D programmes under ITEA, TÜBİTAK and Celtic
- Technology investment, venture and strategic advisory experience

Academic background includes physics, business administration, management information systems and industrial-organisational psychology.
